items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: this is a woman, a Indian woman

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. Well, St. John, this is white people here, this is white people there. From a little girl, I used to go to the grocery store there. It was Sim Street. It was two of me and a brother. It was Sim Street. Now, the old man, my father, if you are a good scientist, it's the man I met, about 18 years. And he's about to have a black one. And so, my father was his place. Now, you can only know the world, the only world, and all white people. Well, I was from young one to the old. Now, when somebody was sick…
No, I'm not well appointed, I don't.
